question: A truck is to be driven 300 km on a highway at a constant speed of $x$ kmph. Speed rules of the highway require that $30\le x\le60$. The fuel costs Rs. 10 per litre and is consumed at the rate of $2+\frac{x^2}{600}$ litres per hour. The wages of the driver are Rs. 200 per hour. The most economical speed to drive the truck, in kmph, is
